based_on.note: The endpoint definition and tick hard cap are copied from the frozen #99 control plan and must not be changed to chase a reproduction number.

modes.name: off
modes.purpose: instrumentation-off control; manifest declares enabled=false and no lifecycle file exists

modes.name: on
modes.purpose: new lifecycle recording; lifecycle-events.jsonl + atomic close receipt

mode_switch.comparison_rule: Compare the common evidence only (boundary state deltas, checksums, RNG, actions, outcomes). The lifecycle_recording capability block/lifecycle files are mode metadata and are excluded from gameplay comparison.

comparisons.name: control_repeatability
comparisons.require: common boundary/state/RNG/action equality within the frozen window

comparisons.name: mode_repeatability
comparisons.require: common boundary/state/RNG/action equality plus valid lifecycle receipt in both

comparisons.name: instrumentation_non_perturbation
comparisons.require: first divergence located and reported; not a pass/fail on event-stream difference alone

comparisons.name: tick940_unknown_path
comparisons.require: scan the whole declared window for removed-without-death-stage entities and report coordinates; must not assume 33 objects

outputs: per-run lifecycle report (tools/issue111_lifecycle_report.py) with coverage limits
off/on and A/B comparison JSON + Markdown with first-divergence coordinates
sealed run directories (gzip evidence codec) and a seal binding run hashes, build hashes and report hashes
explicit verdicts for capture completeness, non-perturbation range, repeatability and first-kill sufficiency
forbidden: overwriting or modifying the four issue #99 trajectories, reports or seals
starting more than one game process at a time
changing stop_when, tick_budget or the declared endpoint after seeing results
installing death/removal/recycle hooks before the candidate-review gate closes
treating event-stream differences alone as an instrumentation failure or as a gameplay fork
claiming a full-window first kill without exact spawn coverage and call-internal ordering
required_reviews: maintainer review of docs/issue111-原生候选证据.md before any death/removal/recycle production hook
maintainer acceptance that stage D may run with only the merged initialization probe if the candidate gate is still open; the tick-940 investigation then reports unavailable at capture level

commands.doctor: python tools/issue111_stage_d.py doctor --root . --plan docs/issue111-阶段D计划.json
